description: A battered notebook with a cracked spine.  Someone has been writing in it every morning: the date, how they slept, whether they ate.  Activate it to read.
//: UltiCa has no sprite for leather_journal (or the book it falls back to), so point straight at a softcover book that UltiCa does draw.
Item use: u is the reader, npc is the journal item. The text is a copy the owner refreshes every morning.
